tok 1.0 "Power supplier switch-over"

pool office "New power supplier"
  lane customer "Customer"
    start request "Switch-over request"
    task transmit "Transmit the customer data to customer service"
    task check_contract "Check the contract details"
    xor decide "Withdraw from the switch contract within 7 days?"
    task withdraw "Withdraw from the switch contract"
    task confirm "Confirm the switch contract"
    xor accepted
    end end_customer "Process ended for the customer"
  lane service "Customer service"
    task receive "Receive the customer data"
    task enter_crm "Enter the customer data object into the CRM system"
    task compare "Compare the customer data with the internal customer database"
    xor exists "Customer exists in the customer database?"
    task new_customer "Create a new customer object"
    xor merge_customer
    task check_data "Check completeness and plausibility"
    xor errors "Errors found?"
    task correct "Correct the errors using the error list"
    task prepare "Prepare the contract documents for the power supplier switch"
    task send_conf "Send the confirmation document to the customer"
    task create_contract "Create the CIS contract"
    task import_meter "Import the meter data into the systems that require it"
    end end_withdrawn "Switch contract withdrawn"
    end end_service "Process of winning a new customer ended"
  lane cis "CIS (customer information system)"
    task cis_check "Check the contract documents automatically in the CIS"
    xor docs_ok "Contract documents generated?"
    task analyze "Analyze and resolve the causing issues"
    task send_request "Send the request to the grid operator automatically"
  lane grid "Grid operator"
    task go_check "Check the switch-over request for supplier concurrence and send response comment"
    xor concurrence "Supplier concurrence?"
    task inform "Inform all involved suppliers and demand the resolution of the conflict"
    task terminate "Terminate the sales agreement with the old supplier"
    and split_meter
    task transmit_meter "Transmit the meter data to customer service and the old supplier"
    task compute_bill "Compute the final billing based on the meter data"
    task send_bill_old "Send the final billing to the old supplier"
    and bill_split
    end end_go "Process ended for the grid operator"
  lane old "Old supplier"
    task create_bill_old "Create and send the final billing to the customer"

flow request -> transmit -> receive -> enter_crm -> compare -> exists
flow exists -> merge_customer "yes"
flow exists -> new_customer "no"
flow new_customer -> merge_customer
flow merge_customer -> check_data -> errors
flow errors -> correct "yes"
flow correct -> check_data
flow errors -> prepare "no"
flow prepare -> cis_check -> docs_ok
flow docs_ok -> analyze "no"
flow analyze -> prepare
flow docs_ok -> send_conf "yes"
flow send_conf -> send_request -> go_check -> concurrence
flow concurrence -> inform "yes"
flow inform -> go_check
flow concurrence -> terminate "no"
flow terminate -> create_contract -> check_contract -> decide
flow decide -> withdraw "yes, within 7 days"
flow withdraw -> end_withdrawn
flow decide -> confirm "confirms"
flow confirm -> accepted
flow decide -> accepted "no withdrawal" default
flow accepted -> split_meter
flow split_meter -> transmit_meter -> import_meter -> end_service
flow split_meter -> compute_bill -> send_bill_old -> bill_split
flow bill_split -> create_bill_old -> end_customer
flow bill_split -> end_go
